microtopic.title: Select the gravity-only projectile model before using projectile consequences
microtopic.inferential_jump: After release in the ideal near-Earth model, projectile motion is not a new set of laws: it is the same component kinematics with a_x=0 and a_y=-g (for +y upward).

construction_units.decision: Decide from what acts after release whether the gravity-only model applies, and only then put a_x = 0 and a_y = −g into the component equations.
Name the requested event as a component condition before solving for its time: v_y = 0 at the apex, Δy = 0 at a return to launch height.
Write the landing event from the actual drop while keeping the actual u_y, then read every requested quantity at that one event time.

microtopic.exit_task_prompt: A stone is launched horizontally from a cliff with speed u. With +y upward and air resistance neglected, write its component acceleration, velocity and displacement relations after release and explain why one common t is used.
